name: VaatiVidya
noteEs: VaatiVidya extendió su cobertura clásica de Souls a Nightreign con una serie dedicada a cada Nightfarer y Nightlord. Los character stories del spin-off siguen el mismo estándar de calidad narrativa que su trabajo con Elden Ring base.
noteEn: VaatiVidya extended his classic Souls coverage to Nightreign with a series dedicated to each Nightfarer and Nightlord. The spin-off's character stories meet the same narrative-quality standard as his base Elden Ring work.
highlightsEs: Serie 'The Story of [Nightfarer]' cubriendo cada personaje del roster
Análisis de Nightlords con conexiones al canon mayor de FromSoftware
Cobertura del DLC Forsaken Hollows con tono crítico-narrativo
Producción cinematográfica usando assets del juego
Misma audiencia/calidad editorial que su trabajo con Elden Ring base
highlightsEn: 'The Story of [Nightfarer]' series covering every roster character
Nightlord analyses with connections to the broader FromSoftware canon
Forsaken Hollows DLC coverage with a critical-narrative tone
Same editorial quality/audience as his base Elden Ring work
